name: Bulbasaur Card
description: The Seed Pokémon. A strange seed was planted on its back at birth.

name: Charmander Card
description: The Lizard Pokémon. The flame on its tail indicates its emotions.

name: Squirtle Card
description: The Tiny Turtle Pokémon. Withdraws into its shell to protect itself.

name: Pikachu Card
description: The Mouse Pokémon. It can generate electric attacks from the electric sacs in its cheeks.

name: Snorlax Card
description: The Sleeping Pokémon. Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. Its enormous belly makes all moves slower.

name: Gengar Card
description: The Shadow Pokémon. Hides in shadows and drains the warmth from the room.

name: Mewtwo Card
description: The Genetic Pokémon. Created from modified Mew genes. A savage Pokémon.

name: Charizard Card
description: The Flame Pokémon. Its fiery breath can melt anything. Spits fire hot enough to melt boulders.

name: Gyarados Card
description: The Atrocious Pokémon. Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, capable of destroying cities.

name: Dragonite Card
description: The Dragon Pokémon. An extremely rare and intelligent Pokémon that can fly faster than any jet.

name: Lugia Card
description: The Diving Pokémon. A legendary bird said to cause storms by flapping its wings.

name: Lucario Card
description: The Aura Pokémon. A Pokémon that can sense and control auras of all things.
